map.两渠道合计收入 260000、花费 100000 → 整体 ROAS=2.6x；: Two channels together produce revenue 260000 on spend 100000, so overall ROAS = 2.6x; any channel with ROAS < 1 should have its share cut and the money moved to efficient channels.
